append.detail: RE-TESTED 2026-10-12 (program premise re-test, ADR-1082). PARTLY, and most of the gate is met by code the probe cannot see. Probe run as written: FAIL on the first seam only (no `add column custom_domain` statement in any migration); the second seam passes (proxy.ts routes by custom domain). What exists: a Space holds its domain in spaces.domain (LIVE-310, feature-meters.ts:483 says so; lib/database.types.ts spaces.domain), proxy.ts:72-77 routeSiteHost rewrites any non-Frequency host to app/hosted/[host] (page, [page], admin/[view]) through lib/sites/host.ts and lib/sites/hosted.ts resolveHostedSpace; a free <slug>.frequencylocal.com subdomain on every published site (LIVE-782, lib/sites/host.ts siteSlugFromSubdomain); self-serve domain binding through the Vercel Domains API (lib/sites/vercel-domains.ts addSiteDomain, addSiteSubdomain, removeSiteDomain, siteDomainStatus, recordsFor) plus domain purchase and renewal through the registrar (lib/sites/registrar.ts, lib/sites/domain-purchase.ts, migration 20270346003100_space_domain_purchases); the custom_domain entitlement and $19 add-on (LIVE-310, LIVE-821); per-tenant theming for sites (lib/sites/editor/theme.ts, theme-contract.json, WEBSITE_THEMES Menswork/DAWN/Midnight); host-aware robots/sitemap (proxy.ts:474-483, lib/sites/host.ts SITE_CRAWLER_FILES); site cache (lib/sites/site-cache.ts). Missing: a site_templates table or gallery (lib/sites/editor/templates.ts WEBSITE_PAGE_TEMPLATES is a constant of page templates, not a store), W5 hardening (no per-site CSP, abuse kill switch at the edge or dangling-DNS cron under lib/sites or app/api/cron), the P7 operator theme controls and theme-contract compile check (no check script names theme-contract), and the W4 white-label purchase/lead flow. The probe asks for a column the implementation never created (the live column is spaces.domain), so it cannot pass without a probe re-point; that is a decision for an owner session, not this re-test.
